newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC HK bond index rose 0.92 pct to 124.75 in May.
newsitem.headline: HSBC HK bond index rose 0.92 pct to 124.75 in May.

text.p: HSBC Markets said its Hong Kong bond index rose to 124.75 in May 1997, a 0.92 percent increase from April 1997.
The sub-index for Hong Kong government paper increased by 0.83 percent, while the sub-index for non-Hong Kong government paper rose by 0.99 percent.

Compared with levels at end-May 1996, the overall index increased by 9.1 percent, the sub-index for Hong Kong government paper rose by 8.2 percent and the sub-index for non-Hong Kong government paper increased by 9.8 percent.
